topic: Configure AWS EFS for Linux Instances
question: How do I configure AWS EFS for Linux instances?
answer: To configure AWS EFS for Linux instances, use the EFS mount helper or the standard Linux NFS client to mount the file system.

course_context.usage: Teams use it to mount scalable file storage on Linux instances in AWS.

workflow: Install amazon-efs-utils on the EC2 instance.
Use the EFS mount helper to mount the file system.
Alternatively, use the NFS client to mount the file system.
Configure automatic mounting on instance start if needed.
Verify the file system is mounted correctly.
devops_application: DevOps teams use it to provide scalable file storage for applications running on EC2 instances.
